title: New moon in Scorpio: one empty chair per house
caption: new moon in scorpio, nov 9. every house set out a chair. who's it for?

beats.text: every house set out one empty chair
no moon tonight. that's the point
it's for whoever's next. not who's gone
new moon in scorpio. it starts in the dark
write what you'd give, not just what you want
beats.sub: on the back of a card

beats.text: scorpio doesn't do halfway. write it all
then three things you won't bend on
who's the chair for? describe them, no names
